selected_script.angle: Stop wiping the car interior with household paper towels that leave lint and streaky glass; switch to the Chemical Guys kit’s dedicated interior cleaner, streak-free glass cleaner, and microfiber towels for a cleaner-looking cabin.
selected_script.hook: I kept using paper towels in my car, and it made the dashboard and glass look worse.

timeline.visual: Handheld close-up inside a parked car in a driveway. A real person wipes the dashboard and inside windshield with crumpled white paper towels. Lint sticks to the dash texture and the windshield catches obvious streaks in natural light.
timeline.voiceover: I kept using paper towels in my car, and it made the dashboard and glass look worse.

timeline.visual: Camera tilts closer to show tiny paper lint pieces on the black dash and hazy wipe marks on the glass. The person rubs the same area again, but the streaks just shift around.
timeline.voiceover: The lint stayed behind, and the streaks just moved around.

timeline.beat: Natural product entry and clear action
timeline.visual: Person reaches to the passenger seat where the Chemical Guys 16-piece kit is neatly set in the blue-white-black-gray camo bucket with large circular Chemical Guys logo. Show the Total Interior Cleaner blue spray bottle, Streak-Free Glass Cleaner spray bottle, and blue microfiber towel clearly, preserving labels, colors, shapes, plastic bottle material, and bucket proportions. Person sprays the towel lightly, wipes the dashboard, then uses the glass cleaner with a microfiber towel on one section of windshield.
timeline.voiceover: So I grabbed the Chemical Guys kit and switched to the interior cleaner, glass cleaner, and microfiber towel.

timeline.beat: Credible before-after result proof and light CTA
timeline.visual: Stable comparable angle from the driver seat: the wiped dash area looks cleaner with less lint, and the windshield section looks clearer with natural reflections. The camo bucket and bottles sit visible on the seat or floor in the background. Person gives a small satisfied nod, no exaggerated shine or chemical effects.
timeline.voiceover: Way cleaner, way less annoying. If your car needs a reset, this kit makes it simple.

scenes.style_notes: Realistic handheld phone-shot UGC, natural daylight, parked car interior, no platform UI, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no exaggerated chemical reactions, no invented accessories.
